title: Tanzanian Tropical Fruit Salad
community: Zanzibar and coastal Tanzania — the island's extraordinary fruit abundance
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Tropical Fruit Salad — fresh mango, pineapple, papaya, passion fruit, watermelon, and banana tossed in a lime-cardamom-honey dressing and scattered with fresh mint and toasted coconut. Zanzibar's extraordinary fruit abundance on a single plate.
longDesc: Tanzania's tropical fruit salad is simply an assembly of what grows here — mango, pineapple, papaya, passion fruit, watermelon, coconut — each at peak ripeness, dressed lightly with lime, cardamom, and honey to unite them without masking their individual characters.
ingredients: 1 large ripe mango — peeled and cubed
½ ripe pineapple — peeled, cored, and cubed
1 ripe papaya — peeled, seeded, and cubed
// Garnish: ¼ cup fresh mint leaves, 3 tbsp toasted coconut flakes
steps: Whisk lime juice, honey, cardamom, and salt until combined.
Combine all prepared fruits in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss gently.
Scatter fresh mint and toasted coconut.
Serve immediately or chill for up to 30 minutes before serving.
chefTips: All fruit must be at perfect ripeness — this dish is entirely about fruit quality.
Dress just before serving — citrus juice draws moisture from the fruit over time.
The cardamom is the Zanzibar signature — do not omit.
commonMistakes: Under-ripe fruit — the entire dish suffers.
cookingScience: Each fruit in this salad contains different dominant acids — citric (pineapple, lime), malic (mango), tartaric (passion fruit). The lime dressing adds additional citric acid which brightens all the other fruits while the honey's fructose rounds any excessive tartness. Cardamom's 1,8-cineole is a volatile aromatic that pairs naturally with all tropical fruits.
sustainabilityTips: All fruits grown in Zanzibar or mainland Tanzania — peak-season, zero food miles.
storage: Best eaten immediately. Maximum 1 hour dressed.
healthBenefits: Exceptional vitamin C from all fruits.
Very high beta-carotene from mango and papaya.
culturalNote: Zanzibar's tropical fruit salad is the island's most honest dessert — a celebration of what grows here, assembled with care and dressed with the island's cardamom and lime. It is the dessert that makes visitors understand what it means to eat where the fruit grows.
